passages.text: This is the burden against Babylon that Isaiah son of Amoz received: Raise a banner on a barren hilltop; call aloud to them. Wave your hand, that they may enter the gates of the nobles.
passages.sermon:
Isaiah is a prophet.
Isaiah is the son of Amoz.
God gave Isaiah a message.
This message is a prophecy against Babylon.
Raise a banner on a barren hilltop.
Call out loudly to the people.
Wave your hand to signal them.
They will enter the gates of the nobles.
passages.original: מַשָּׂ֖א בָּבֶ֑ל אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָזָ֔ה יְשַׁעְיָ֖הוּ בֶּן־ אָמֽוֹץ׃ עַ֤ל הַר־ נִשְׁפֶּה֙ שְֽׂאוּ־ נֵ֔ס הָרִ֥ימוּ ק֖וֹל לָהֶ֑ם הָנִ֣יפוּ יָ֔ד וְיָבֹ֖אוּ פִּתְחֵ֥י נְדִיבִֽים׃

passages.text: I have commanded My sanctified ones; I have even summoned My warriors to execute My wrath and exult in My triumph.
passages.sermon:
God speaks in this passage.
God gives commands to His sanctified ones.
God calls His warriors.
God calls them to carry out His anger.
God’s warriors rejoice in His greatness.
passages.original: אֲנִ֥י צִוֵּ֖יתִי לִמְקֻדָּשָׁ֑י גַּ֣ם קָרָ֤אתִי גִבּוֹרַי֙ לְאַפִּ֔י עַלִּיזֵ֖י גַּאֲוָתִֽי׃

passages.text: Listen, a tumult on the mountains, like that of a great multitude! Listen, an uproar among the kingdoms, like nations gathered together! The LORD of Hosts is mobilizing an army for war.
passages.sermon:
Isaiah is a prophet.
Isaiah is the son of Amoz.
Isaiah received a message from God.
This message is about Babylon.
There is a loud noise on the mountains.
The noise sounds like a great crowd of people.
There is an uproar among many kingdoms.
Many nations are gathering together.
The LORD of Hosts is in command.
The LORD is gathering an army for war.
passages.original: ק֥וֹל הָמ֛וֹן בֶּֽהָרִ֖ים דְּמ֣וּת עַם־ רָ֑ב ק֠וֹל שְׁא֞וֹן מַמְלְכ֤וֹת גּוֹיִם֙ נֶֽאֱסָפִ֔ים יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת מְפַקֵּ֖ד צְבָ֥א מִלְחָמָֽה׃

passages.text: They are coming from faraway lands, from the ends of the heavens— the LORD and the weapons of His wrath— to destroy the whole country.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is coming.
He brings His weapons of wrath.
They come from faraway lands.
They come from the ends of the heavens.
The LORD and His weapons come together.
They come to destroy the whole country.
passages.original: בָּאִ֛ים מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מֶרְחָ֖ק מִקְצֵ֣ה הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם יְהוָה֙ וּכְלֵ֣י זַעְמ֔וֹ לְחַבֵּ֖ל כָּל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: Wail, for the Day of the LORD is near; it will come as destruction from the Almighty.
passages.sermon:
The Day of the LORD is near.
The LORD is the Almighty God.
Destruction will come from the Almighty.
Wail, because this day is coming soon.
passages.original: הֵילִ֕ילוּ כִּ֥י קָר֖וֹב י֣וֹם יְהוָ֑ה כְּשֹׁ֖ד מִשַּׁדַּ֥י יָבֽוֹא׃

passages.text: Therefore all hands will fall limp, and every man’s heart will melt.
passages.sermon:
God is bringing destruction to the whole land.
He is coming with His wrath.
Because of this, every person will lose strength in their hands.
Every person’s heart will melt with fear.
passages.original: עַל־ כֵּ֖ן כָּל־ יָדַ֣יִם תִּרְפֶּ֑ינָה וְכָל־ לְבַ֥ב אֱנ֖וֹשׁ יִמָּס׃

passages.text: Terror, pain, and anguish will seize them; they will writhe like a woman in labor. They will look at one another, their faces flushed with fear.
passages.sermon:
God will bring the Day of the LORD.
This day will cause terror, pain, and anguish.
Terror will seize the people.
Pain will grip them.
Anguish will take hold of them.
They will suffer like a woman in labor.
Each person will look at his neighbor.
They will be amazed at each other.
Their faces will burn with fear.
passages.original: וְֽנִבְהָ֓לוּ׀ צִירִ֤ים וַֽחֲבָלִים֙ יֹֽאחֵז֔וּן כַּיּוֹלֵדָ֖ה יְחִיל֑וּן אִ֤ישׁ אֶל־ רֵעֵ֙הוּ֙ יִתְמָ֔הוּ פְּנֵ֥י לְהָבִ֖ים פְּנֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: Behold, the Day of the LORD is coming— cruel, with fury and burning anger— to make the earth a desolation and to destroy the sinners within it.
passages.sermon:
The Day of the LORD is coming.
The LORD is just and powerful.
This day will be cruel.
It will come with fury.
It will come with burning anger.
The LORD will make the earth a desolation.
He will destroy the sinners who live in the earth.
passages.original: הִנֵּ֤ה יוֹם־ יְהוָה֙ בָּ֔א אַכְזָרִ֥י וְעֶבְרָ֖ה וַחֲר֣וֹן אָ֑ף לָשׂ֤וּם הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ לְשַׁמָּ֔ה וְחַטָּאֶ֖יהָ יַשְׁמִ֥יד מִמֶּֽנָּה׃

passages.text: For the stars of heaven and their constellations will not give their light. The rising sun will be darkened, and the moon will not give its light.
passages.sermon:
God will act with great power and anger.
He will judge the earth and its people.
The stars in the sky will not shine.
The constellations will not give their light.
The sun will be dark when it rises.
The moon will not shine at night.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ כוֹכְבֵ֤י הַשָּׁמַ֙יִם֙ וּכְסִ֣ילֵיהֶ֔ם לֹ֥א יָהֵ֖לּוּ אוֹרָ֑ם חָשַׁ֤ךְ הַשֶּׁ֙מֶשׁ֙ בְּצֵאת֔וֹ וְיָרֵ֖חַ לֹֽא־ יַגִּ֥יהַ אוֹרֽוֹ׃

passages.text: I will punish the world for its evil and the wicked for their iniquity. I will end the haughtiness of the arrogant and lay low the pride of the ruthless.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the holy and righteous judge.
The LORD will punish the world for its evil.
The LORD will punish wicked people for their sins.
The LORD will stop the pride of arrogant people.
The LORD will bring down the pride of cruel people.
passages.original: וּפָקַדְתִּ֤י עַל־ תֵּבֵל֙ רָעָ֔ה וְעַל־ רְשָׁעִ֖ים עֲוֺנָ֑ם וְהִשְׁבַּתִּי֙ גְּא֣וֹן זֵדִ֔ים וְגַאֲוַ֥ת עָרִיצִ֖ים אַשְׁפִּֽיל׃

passages.text: I will make man scarcer than pure gold, and mankind rarer than the gold of Ophir.
passages.sermon:
God speaks about His coming judgment.
God says He will punish the world for its evil.
He will punish the wicked for their sins.
God will make people very rare.
People will be harder to find than pure gold.
People will be fewer than the gold of Ophir.
Gold of Ophir is very rare and precious.
God will make mankind even rarer than this gold.
passages.original: אוֹקִ֥יר אֱנ֖וֹשׁ מִפָּ֑ז וְאָדָ֖ם מִכֶּ֥תֶם אוֹפִֽיר׃

passages.text: Therefore I will make the heavens tremble, and the earth will be shaken from its place at the wrath of the LORD of Hosts on the day of His burning anger.
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts is powerful and just.
He will show His wrath and burning anger.
He will make the heavens tremble.
He will shake the earth from its place.
This will happen on the day of His fierce anger.
passages.original: עַל־ כֵּן֙ שָׁמַ֣יִם אַרְגִּ֔יז וְתִרְעַ֥שׁ הָאָ֖רֶץ מִמְּקוֹמָ֑הּ בְּעֶבְרַת֙ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֔וֹת וּבְי֖וֹם חֲר֥וֹן אַפּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Like a hunted gazelle, like a sheep without a shepherd, each will return to his own people, each will flee to his native land.
passages.sermon:
God will judge the people.
They will be afraid.
They will be like a gazelle that someone hunts.
They will be like sheep that have no shepherd.
No one will gather them together.
Each person will go back to his own people.
Each person will run to his own land.
passages.original: וְהָיָה֙ כִּצְבִ֣י מֻדָּ֔ח וּכְצֹ֖אן וְאֵ֣ין מְקַבֵּ֑ץ אִ֤ישׁ אֶל־ עַמּוֹ֙ יִפְנ֔וּ וְאִ֥ישׁ אֶל־ אַרְצ֖וֹ יָנֽוּסוּ׃

passages.text: Whoever is caught will be stabbed, and whoever is captured will die by the sword.
passages.sermon:
God is angry.
God will punish the people.
Anyone who is found will be stabbed.
Anyone who is captured will die by the sword.
passages.original: כָּל־ הַנִּמְצָ֖א יִדָּקֵ֑ר וְכָל־ הַנִּסְפֶּ֖ה יִפּ֥וֹל בֶּחָֽרֶב׃

passages.text: Their infants will be dashed to pieces before their eyes, their houses will be looted, and their wives will be ravished.
passages.sermon:
The people of Babylon will suffer.
Enemies will dash their infants to pieces.
This will happen in front of the parents’ eyes.
Enemies will loot their houses.
Enemies will violate their wives.
passages.original: וְעֹלְלֵיהֶ֥ם יְרֻטְּשׁ֖וּ לְעֵֽינֵיהֶ֑ם יִשַּׁ֙סּוּ֙ בָּֽתֵּיהֶ֔ם וּנְשֵׁיהֶ֖ם תִּשָּׁגַלְנָה׃

passages.text: Behold, I will stir up against them the Medes, who have no regard for silver and no desire for gold.
passages.sermon:
God speaks about Babylon.
God says, "I will bring the Medes against Babylon."
The Medes do not care about silver.
The Medes do not want gold.
passages.original: הִנְנִ֛י מֵעִ֥יר עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם אֶת־ מָדָ֑י אֲשֶׁר־ כֶּ֙סֶף֙ לֹ֣א יַחְשֹׁ֔בוּ וְזָהָ֖ב לֹ֥א יַחְפְּצוּ־ בֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Their bows will dash young men to pieces; they will have no mercy on the fruit of the womb; they will not look with pity on the children.
passages.sermon:
The Medes will attack Babylon.
The Medes will use their bows.
Their bows will kill young men.
The Medes will show no mercy to babies.
They will not feel pity for children.
They will destroy without compassion.
passages.original: וּקְשָׁת֖וֹת נְעָרִ֣ים תְּרַטַּ֑שְׁנָה וּפְרִי־ בֶ֙טֶן֙ לֹ֣א יְרַחֵ֔מוּ עַל־ בָּנִ֖ים לֹֽא־ תָח֥וּס עֵינָֽם׃

passages.text: And Babylon, the jewel of the kingdoms, the glory of the pride of the Chaldeans, will be overthrown by God like Sodom and Gomorrah.
passages.sermon:
Babylon was the most beautiful of all kingdoms.
Babylon was the pride and glory of the Chaldeans.
God will destroy Babylon.
God will overthrow Babylon like He did to Sodom and Gomorrah.
passages.original: וְהָיְתָ֤ה בָבֶל֙ צְבִ֣י מַמְלָכ֔וֹת תִּפְאֶ֖רֶת גְּא֣וֹן כַּשְׂדִּ֑ים כְּמַהְפֵּכַ֣ת אֱלֹהִ֔ים אֶת־ סְדֹ֖ם וְאֶת־ עֲמֹרָֽה׃

passages.text: She will never be inhabited or settled from generation to generation; no nomad will pitch his tent there, no shepherd will rest his flock there.
passages.sermon:
Babylon was a great and proud city.
God will destroy Babylon.
No one will ever live in Babylon again.
No one will settle there in any future generation.
No nomad will ever pitch his tent there.
No shepherd will ever rest his flock there.
passages.original: לֹֽא־ תֵשֵׁ֣ב לָנֶ֔צַח וְלֹ֥א תִשְׁכֹּ֖ן עַד־ דּ֣וֹר וָד֑וֹר וְלֹֽא־ יַהֵ֥ל שָׁם֙ עֲרָבִ֔י וְרֹעִ֖ים לֹא־ יַרְבִּ֥צוּ שָֽׁם׃

passages.text: But desert creatures will lie down there, and howling creatures will fill her houses. Ostriches will dwell there, and wild goats will leap about.
passages.sermon:
Desert creatures will lie down in Babylon.
Howling creatures will fill Babylon’s houses.
Ostriches will live there.
Wild goats will leap there.
passages.original: וְרָבְצוּ־ שָׁ֣ם צִיִּ֔ים וּמָלְא֥וּ בָתֵּיהֶ֖ם אֹחִ֑ים וְשָׁ֤כְנוּ שָׁם֙ בְּנ֣וֹת יַֽעֲנָ֔ה וּשְׂעִירִ֖ים יְרַקְּדוּ־ שָֽׁם׃

passages.text: Hyenas will howl in her fortresses and jackals in her luxurious palaces. Babylon’s time is at hand, and her days will not be prolonged.
passages.sermon:
Babylon is a great city.
Hyenas will howl in Babylon’s fortresses.
Jackals will cry out in Babylon’s luxurious palaces.
Babylon’s time is near.
Babylon’s days will not last long.
passages.original: וְעָנָ֤ה אִיִּים֙ בְּאַלְמנוֹתָ֔יו וְתַנִּ֖ים בְּהֵ֣יכְלֵי עֹ֑נֶג וְקָר֤וֹב לָבוֹא֙ עִתָּ֔הּ וְיָמֶ֖יהָ לֹ֥א יִמָּשֵֽׁכוּ׃
